name: gtm-ontology-framework
description: GTM Ontology Framework plugins — build evidence-backed company context and agent-ready business ontologies of your CRM/GTM stack.

plugins.name: gtm-ontology-builder
plugins.description: Build evidence-backed company context and agent-ready GTM ontologies. Three skills: company-context-builder inventories products, ICPs, personas, positioning, and won CRM evidence; gtm-ontology-builder models CRM objects, custom fields, pipelines, automations, agent actions, governance, and KPIs for Pipedrive, HubSpot, Attio, Salesforce, email marketing, and ERP; gtm-context-evaluator runs competency evals against the result. Bundles the renderer, JSON schemas, and a complete worked example.
